newsitem.title: ITALY: PopMilano bank reduces prime to 8.50 pct.
newsitem.headline: PopMilano bank reduces prime to 8.50 pct.

text.p: Italy's Banca Popolare Milano said it was cutting its prime lending rate to 8.50 percent from 8.75 percent, effective from July 2.
The bank said its top lending rate remained unchanged at 16 percent.
Earlier on Tuesday, Italy's largest savings bank Cariplo said it was cutting its prime rate 50 basis points to 8.50 percent and its top rate 25 basis points to 15.50 percent from July 7.
Cariplo was the first of Italy's big banks to lower its lending rates below 9.0 percent following a Bank of Italy rate cut of 50 basis points last Friday.
